messages:
aparna: FYI PR #4188 failing snippets for optimize/README: java and js examples use old QuantProfile and old batching key.

jess: ugh, saw that; docs CI shows snippet-runner errors for java and node.

samir: error trace: NoClassDefFoundError com/redwood/optimize/QuantProfile at java-snippet-builder.

matt: looks like runtime refactor moved profiles to com.redwood.optimize.profiles and renamed batching config key to max_batch_tokens.

aparna: plan: small docs-only PR that updates snippets, adds a short migration note, and a grep-based CI check to catch old import. keep to optimize/quantization and optimize/batching pages.

jess: I'll prepare PR 4189 with changes. will update java example to: ```java
import com.redwood.optimize.profiles.QuantProfileV2;
QuantProfileV2 qp = QuantProfileV2.fromPreset("int8_balanced");
```

samir: node snippet change: ```js
const { QuantProfile } = require('@redwood/optimize/profiles');
const qp = QuantProfile.fromPreset('int8_balanced');
```

matt: also update YAML batching snippet to: ```yaml
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  max_concurrent_requests: 8
```

jess: added a short h3 migration header: "Quant profiles and batching config changes (runtime v2)" with examples and a callout.

samir: running locally: `tools/snippet-runner --langs java,node --path docs/optimize` — found a markdown fence indentation issue in caching.md, fixed.

docs-bot: CI: docs-site / build (failed) — snippet tests failing on line vs code fence in caching.md.

jess: pushed fix for caching formatting and rebased.

docs-bot: CI: docs-site / build (pending) — snippet tests running.

matt: adding a lightweight git grep check in docs pipeline to fail if `com.redwood.optimize.QuantProfile` is present. PR updated.

jess: CI green on branch fix/snippets-4189. PR 4189 opened: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pull/4189 — includes java/node snippet fixes, YAML update, migration note, caching MD fix, and grep CI check.

aparna: awesome. once merged, update change log and add a one-liner to the Optimize docs intro so customers see breaking change in release notes.

samir: will run snippet-runner on merge commit and report back in this thread.

docs-bot: CI: docs-site / build (success) — snippets passed. PR merged by jess.

jess: merged. ping me if anything else flares up; we'll follow with a tiny QA sweep next week.

matt: opening infra PR to centralize the grep check in docs-ci and add an allowlist for legacy code samples (for archived content).

aparna: tagging product for release notes: @product Please include the note about batching key rename and quant profile package change in the next release email.

product: noted, will include concise bullet in release highlights.

samir: all good from my side. closing local harness run: success.

aparna: thanks team :rocket:
